messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the webinar next Wed. Need owners for: registration page copy QA, Zoom config (cloud recording + captions + SRT export), greenroom checklist, and post-event routing (HubSpot + clips). Can someone take end-to-end?

Liam: I can own the lead routing + nurture flows. Need the registration form to include hidden campaign params and a short 'primary use case' question. Also: phone field if we want SMS confirm.

Sara: I’ll take reg page QA and greenroom script. Draft reg copy here: https://docs.google.com/example (WIP). For Zoom: set cloud recording, enable audio transcript/captions, save chat to cloud. Who will be alt host?

Alex: Ops can be alt host and will confirm cloud recording settings. We can auto-export SRT to our S3 bucket. Need a service account with put permissions.

ops-bot: Automation note: Cloud recording scheduled for webinar_id=2470012345. Post-process export -> s3://redwood-webinars/2470012345/ (mp4, srt, chat.txt).

Maya: Two asks: 1) can we do a short pre-event SMS confirmation (US only)? 2) post-event assets: full recording, 3 highlight clips, and a cleaned transcript (SRT->VTT). Who edits clips?

Liam: SMS is doable via Braze — requires phone + opt-in checkbox on reg form. For clips, marketing edits but needs raw SRT and timecodes. Recommend we add manual timestamp markers during the event (greenroom cue).

Sara: I'll create a greenroom cue sheet (will add to the doc). Also set Zoom to record: 'Active Speaker' + 'Gallery' so editors have both angles. Enable 'save chat' so we capture links/questions.

Alex: Ops plan: after Zoom export completes -> lambda will copy files to S3, generate thumbnails, then POST a webhook to /marketing/ingest with manifest. I will add HubSpot mapping: lifecycle_stage=lead, source=webinar_gatekeeper. Need HubSpot list name from Liam.

Liam: HubSpot details: list name = "webinar_gatekeeper_042026", tag = "webinar-gatekeeper-0426". Workflow: if registrant checked 'Talk to sales' -> SLA: push to #sales-inbound + assign to on-call AE within 1 hour. Otherwise go into 7-email nurture over 21 days.

Maya: Nice. Small technical detail: can the SRT be auto-converted to plain transcript and VTT? We want both captions and a cleaned transcript for blog republish.

Alex: Yes — post-process will run a conversion job: srt -> plain text (strip timestamps) and srt -> vtt. I’ll add conversion step after export.

Sara: Checklist (quick): 1) reg copy QA 2) hidden campaign params + phone + opt-in 3) Zoom settings: cloud rec, captions, save chat, active+gallery 4) alt host set to Alex 5) greenroom cues 6) post-process S3 path + webhook 7) HubSpot mapping 8) clip owners assigned. I’ll share a one-pager and check it off EOD Fri.

Maya: Perfect. @Liam pls confirm HubSpot workflow triggers and the Slack alert channel. Also can you draft the 7-email nurture skeleton so we can review?

Liam: Confirmed. I'll wire the workflow and draft emails today. Will post copy in this thread and ping for review.

Maya: :thumbsup: If no blockers, we lock settings tomorrow morning. Ping here for any last-minute changes. Thanks team!
